meta.parties: Ukku Menika Et Al. v. Lape

rules.statement: An order giving a plaintiff liberty to re-institute an action after it has been dismissed without calling on the defense is inoperative if made without jurisdiction, and does not prevent the defendant from raising res judicata.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the order giving the plaintiff liberty to re-institute the action was inoperative, as being made without jurisdiction, and that the said order did not prevent the defendant from successfully raising the plea of res judicata, if sued again on the same cause of action."
